The '''Valtha Divide''' was a distant space location where a living [[Teezl]] was found and captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel]] later used the [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]] [[Helmsman (battlecruiser)|''Helmsman'']] to transport it to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
